name: BossDB TIFF Export
desc: Export a public BossDB precomputed cutout as a 3D TIFF or TIFF slices.

x_start.desc: Inclusive starting X coordinate at the selected mip

y_start.desc: Inclusive starting Y coordinate at the selected mip

z_start.desc: Inclusive starting Z coordinate at the selected mip

x_stop.desc: Exclusive ending X coordinate at the selected mip

y_stop.desc: Exclusive ending Y coordinate at the selected mip

z_stop.desc: Exclusive ending Z coordinate at the selected mip

resolution.desc: Precomputed mip level; 0 is base resolution

export_as_volume.desc: Write one 3D TIFF instead of individual Z slices
